description: This Java class 'FundTransferService' provides service-layer functionality for handling fund transfer operations in a financial application. It manages creating transfer entities, invoking external banking client APIs, updating transaction statuses, and retrieving transfer histories.

classes.name: FundTransferService
classes.description: A Spring Service component that handles fund transfer operations, including initiating transfers and retrieving transfer history.

methods.name: fundTransfer
methods.description: Handles the process of executing a fund transfer request, updates transfer status, and returns a response object.

methods.name: readAllTransfers
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all fund transfers, converted to DTOs.
